comment: Sameness-court gold pins (2026-08-30), amended same day by the merge-batch repair (plans/merge-batch-audit.md): the corpus-global law made entity merge IDENTITY-ONLY, so the narration/channel same-restaurant fold pins flipped to new, and every wrong-class from the executed sweep batch is pinned on its correct side (with the true synonyms pinned merge). Context fields mirror the D2 wire: mention/threadPlace/termHomePlaces on the case, homePlaces/samePlace (mention hearings only) on candidates.

acceptance pin 2026-08-30: the dedupe judge merged these as a 'spelling variant' — wrong: bourbon is whisky and is not scotch; scotch is a regional subtype, whisky the category. Subtype vs category = two claims.
acceptance pin 2026-08-30: the judge merged 'barbecue sauce' into 'bbq' while itself ruling 'bbq sauce' vs 'bbq' = new — transitivity-inconsistent. A sauce is not the flavor/tradition category.
wave-sweep wrong merge (audit): format fold — carnitas (the meat/dish, 15 restaurants) is corpus-global; 'tacos' is a format a diner orders on purpose
the same pair in the other direction — a subtype/format never folds into its base in EITHER direction
